name: John Caudwell
current_role: Investor and philanthropist; founder/chair of Caudwell Children and Caudwell LymeCo (ex-founder of Phones 4u)
profile: Stoke-raised entrepreneur who started wholesaling mobile phones with brother Brian in 1987, built Singlepoint (sold to Vodafone 2003) and Phones 4u, the UK's largest independent phone retailer, and sold out in 2006 and 2011. Now invests in property, fashion and other businesses and runs his charities; Giving Pledge signatory since 2013.
interesting_fact: He founded Caudwell Children in 2000 and in 2019 opened the Caudwell International Children's Centre in Staffordshire, providing services for autistic children.
deep_cut_fact: Before phones he was an engineering apprentice-turned-foreman at Michelin, earning an HNC in mechanical engineering while running a corner shop and a mail-order clothing business for motorcyclists on the side; he later owned the F1 powerboat team Caudwell Racing (2012-14).
notes: Media-friendly, frequent interviewee (podcasts, speaker agencies). Best route is via Caudwell Children PR or his Caudwell office (caudwell.com). Keen long-distance cyclist; avoid Lyme-disease controversy angle.

name: lin Wenjing
profile: Lin Wenjing (Sutanto Djuhar, 1928-2018), Fuqing-born Indonesian-Chinese co-founder of the Salim Group, returned to Fuqing in 1987 and founded Rongqiao Group in 1989; died 2 July 2018.
notes: Deceased (2 July 2018) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sutanto_Djuhar. Rongqiao Group / Lin Wenjing Foundation now run by family; the Forbes listing may refer to heirs.
